facts.text: EGGS, BACON, TOAST. NO ROBOT ARM
facts.why: The film's opening shows Doc's automatic dog food opener and a malfunctioning toaster. The sources I opened show no robot arm making breakfast.
facts.fix: EGGS, BACON, TOAST. WATCH THE TOASTER

facts.why: The note says Lou's counter, two straws. In the Lou's scene Marty asks for a drink with no sugar and George sits nearby. No source I opened has a shared malt.
facts.fix: Lou's Cafe chocolate milk, no sugar needed
